Implementation Plan

Planning context interpreted
- Clarification mapping: no `Q<ID>` questions existed; `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` confirms proceeding with the issue scope as written.
- Ref context: `HEAD=58f752b7ff161903029e5b035a9d90e852de3685`, checkout ref `orchestrator/project-1170`, integration metadata `orchestrator/project-1170`, mismatch `false`.

Representative implementation patterns to follow
- `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` for `gh workflow run` dispatch + inactivity-based polling (`gh_api_safe`, run-id capture, timeout reset on progress).
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (`extract_comprehensive_release_metadata`) for callback metadata parsing contract.
- `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py` for checkout@v5 workflow classification requirements.

Conflict notes
- `docs/comprehensive-test-and-release-plan.md` describes broader changes (collector/analyzer/poller), but this issue scope is intentionally narrower; implementation should stay within requested files.
- Poller callback currently parses `version_tag:` / `test_repo:` key-value lines, not JSON-only metadata. The new metadata comment must include parser-compatible key-value lines for callback consumption without changing poller core logic.

Checklist (mapped to issue scope)
- [ ] Add `.github/workflows/comprehensive-test-and-release.yml` with required `workflow_dispatch` inputs.
- [ ] Implement Phase 1 dispatch/poll for `test-and-mark-stable.yml` with inactivity timeout.
- [ ] Implement Phase 2 dispatch/poll for `workflow-log-analysis.yml` (`codex_mode=true`), safe timestamp update, commit only on change.
- [ ] Implement Phase 3 dispatch for `internal-orchestrate.yml` with report-linked description, then deterministically tag tracking issue and post metadata comment.
- [ ] Add seed file `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt`.
- [ ] Update checkout-audit classification test if new workflow uses `actions/checkout@v5`.

Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/comprehensive-test-and-release.yml` (new)
- `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` (new)
- `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py` (allowlist update if checkout@v5 is used)

Functions/modules to implement
- New workflow job `phase1-first-pass-test`:
  - Dispatch `test-and-mark-stable.yml` with `dry_run=true`, optional `version_tag`/`test_repo`.
  - Poll run status with inactivity timeout (`phase_timeout`) and rate-limit-safe API handling.
- New workflow job `phase2-collect-and-analyze-logs`:
  - Read `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` safely; if missing/invalid, use `lookback_days_fallback`.
  - Dispatch `workflow-log-analysis.yml` with `codex_mode=true` and `since`/`lookback_days`.
  - Poll to completion with inactivity timeout.
  - Update `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` with UTC ISO-8601 timestamp and commit/push only if file content changed.
- New workflow job `phase3-dispatch-orchestrator`:
  - Resolve latest analysis report path committed under `analysis/`.
  - Dispatch `internal-orchestrate.yml` with report-linked `project_description`.
  - Deterministically identify the newly created tracking issue (pre/post snapshot of `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue set; fail on ambiguity instead of guessing).
  - Ensure `ai:comprehensive-test-pending` label exists, apply it, and post metadata comment containing parser-compatible lines (`version_tag`, `test_repo`) plus run context.
- Audit test update:
  - If checkout@v5 is present in the new workflow, add `comprehensive-test-and-release.yml` to `ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS` with rationale.

Data structures affected
- `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt`: single-line UTC ISO-8601 timestamp.
- Tracking issue metadata comment: machine-readable key/value lines consumed by existing callback parser.
- Workflow step outputs/env: dispatched run ids, resolved report path, detected tracking issue number.

API/interface changes
- New manual workflow inputs:
  - `version_tag` (string)
  - `test_repo` (string)
  - `phase_timeout` (number)
  - `lookback_days_fallback` (number)
- No changes to existing workflow APIs or poller/orchestrator core interfaces.

Potential risks and edge cases
- Run matching ambiguity when multiple workflow runs start concurrently; mitigate with created-after timestamp + uniqueness checks.
- GitHub API rate limiting during polling/tagging; mitigate with safe API wrapper + backoff.
- Timestamp commit races vs. report commit from `workflow-log-analysis`; mitigate with fetch/rebase before push.
- Ambiguous tracking issue detection if multiple new tracking issues appear; fail explicitly instead of tagging wrong issue.
- Invalid/empty `version_tag` or `test_repo`; preserve callback compatibility by emitting sanitized or blank values.

Testing considerations
- Run `python3 tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py`.
- Run workflow linting (`yamllint`, `actionlint`) to validate new YAML.
- Manual workflow_dispatch dry run to verify:
  - Phase 1 and Phase 2 polling behavior and timeout handling.
  - Timestamp file update and “commit only when changed” behavior.
  - Deterministic tracking issue tagging + metadata comment attachment after orchestrator dispatch.
- Confirm no MongoDB contract or index impact (none expected).
